roadmap: Step 1 [PERFORMANCE]: Split long JavaScript tasks to minimize Total Blocking Time (HARD | Est Time: 3 hours) - Break up long tasks (>50ms) using scheduler.yield() or requestIdleCallback(), defer non-critical JavaScript execution, and offload CPU-intensive work to Web Workers.

Step 2 [SEO]: Provide a meta description for search engine result snippets (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Declare a <meta name="description" content="..."> tag (120-160 characters) in the page <head> section.

Step 3 [PERFORMANCE]: Investigate unused code / code splitting for JavaScript scripts (HARD | Est Time: 4 hours) - Investigate unused code / code splitting: CDP runtime coverage observes unexecuted code during initial load, not dead code. Defer non-critical interactive code using dynamic import() route-based code splitting. Do not assume tree-shaking is applicable unless build-time static analysis confirms unreferenced exports.
Step 4 [PERFORMANCE]: Implement lazy loading for below-the-fold images (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add loading="lazy" attribute to all 6 images that appear below the viewport fold.
Step 5 [SEO]: Provide a canonical URL link tag (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Declare <link rel="canonical" href="https://example.com/authoritative-path"> in the <head> of every page.
Step 6 [ACCESSIBILITY]: Add a skip navigation link for keyboard users (EASY | Est Time: 15 mins) - Add an accessible skip link as the very first focusable element inside , e.g. Skip to main content.
